title: Lab dataset and version tracker

provenance.origin: Written for the AstaUI prototype; not a real participant's work.

notes: Thirty datasets are listed by hand; their version histories are generated from a list of typical processing steps per instrument. Status, paper version, paper name and notes are saved in the browser's localStorage, not written back to the lab share, and the location paths are invented. Inspired by a formative-study pattern (a participant who kept many versions of instrument exports and lost track of which one was used), but the data and wording are synthetic.
